title: Facadeur document
description: Nested facadeur document. Nodes are frame, text, image, or instance. Tokens are a DTCG tree. Fonts list families and their sources. A style block paints the component. Instances override fields and variants only.

dtcgNode.description: DTCG group or token. $value makes an object a token. Group $type is inherited. Child names match [a-z0-9]+.
